name: Adoption ladder section
description: Defines the README adoption ladder as structured generated documentation.
heading: Adoption ladder

levels.title: Level 1: Canonical glossary
levels.description: Use Grounded for important project terms.
levels.good_for: domain language, renamed concepts, avoiding duplicate terminology, and giving LLMs stable vocabulary

levels.title: Level 2: Rules and decisions
levels.description: Add business rules, architecture decisions, assumptions, examples, and workflows.
levels.good_for: keeping design intent visible and linking implementation plans to stable IDs

levels.title: Level 3: Generated docs and LLM context
levels.description: Render human docs and LLM-readable context from the same specs.
levels.good_for: onboarding, code review, agent workflows, and reducing stale prompt instructions

levels.title: Level 4: Verification and drift checks
levels.description: Use verification specs and audits to prove that important facts still have checks.
levels.good_for: CI, semantic contracts, executable documentation, and project governance
